reason: Synthetic selection optimizes row-hit in 6h credit window; measured eval requires episode notification within 6h of onset. Labels are 6h post-onset credit blocks, not full ongoing leak presence; open-leak times after 6h are negative.

labels.definition: y(t)=1 iff t in [leak_start, leak_start+6h] on 5-minute grid

synthetic_selection.metric: scenario_recall = fraction of leak scenarios with >=1 row q>=tau and y==1

measured_objective.metric: abrupt_6h recall via episode notify_time in [onset, onset+6h]
